**Chinese name:** 东芯半导体股份有限公司 (Dōngxīn Gǔfèn)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
A two-story firm: a niche-memory designer riding the 2025-26 shortage to 67.7% gross margin and H1 2026 net profit ¥6.59亿 (vs FY2025 loss), and a listed proxy for Lingxi's consumer GPU incubation (¥0.42亿 equity loss H1). If the 7G100 scales, the off-balance-sheet GPU template becomes the model for design houses nurturing advanced logic.
:::

## What does this firm design?

SLC/MLC NAND, NOR, niche DRAM and MCP/eMMC combos; affiliate's 6nm graphics GPUs.

## Key Facts

| | |
|---|---|
| **Category** | Fabless |
| **Founded** | 2014 |
| **Location** | Shanghai, Shanghai Municipality |
| **Product Focus** | Niche small-capacity memory — SLC NAND (domestic leader), NOR, DDR3/LPDDR4x DRAM, MCP combos for phone/module platforms |
| **Node Sophistication** | 1x-nm-class SLC NAND in volume; affiliate Lingxi 7G100 GPU on 6nm (taped out early 2025, retail May/July 2026; 4th globally WHQL-certified Windows GPU vendor) |
| **Entity List** | No |
